items.title: Visa (V) Is Buying BioCatch To Take On AI Driven Payments Fraud
items.summary: Visa has agreed to acquire BioCatch, an AI powered fraud intelligence company focused on detecting and preventing digital payments fraud. The deal is aimed at strengthening Visa's cybersecurity tools across its global payments network and services for banks, merchants and consumers. The acquisition comes as digital scammers increasingly use AI driven tactics to target online transactions and accounts.
